items.title: Hide targets by itself, and isn't Doomed through a wall
items.do: Put Kaela behind a wall from Goblin Sneak (it can't see her) and behind a crate from Orc Warrior (High Cover; it sees her). Target nobody and click Hide.
items.expect: It targets the Goblin and the Orc by itself (not a creature that sees her without High Cover); the roll against each is not Doomed (no Hidden or No Line of Effect penalty), only against its Instinct DC. Afterwards, with the Goblin selected (its vision), Kaela shows no sound ripple to it (Unsensed); the Orc still has its ripple or sight of her.

items.title: The HUD's Basic tab in five columns
items.do: Select Kaela and open the HUD's Basic tab. Then select Orc Warrior.
items.expect: Five columns: Attack, Movement, Control, Stealth (Hide, Sneak, Seek, Point Out, Lean), Utility, five or six Actions each, none cut off. The Actions tab on the sheet keeps its four groups.

items.title: A card's Check button posts the new Check card
items.do: Target Goblin Sneak and use Tumble with Kaela; in its chat card click Appeal Check.
items.expect: The result is the new card (the stamp, the ladder against the DC, the breakdown), titled "Appeal Check vs Goblin Sneak", against the Goblin's Appeal DC. Not the old block with a Tier table.

items.title: Seek finds, Point Out shows
items.do: With Kaela Unsensed to Goblin Sneak and Hidden to Orc Warrior from Hide, on the Goblin's turn click Seek in the HUD (the 1 AP and the 2 AP Version once each), without targeting anyone. On the Orc's turn, use Point Out on Kaela (the Orc must perceive her better than the Goblin does).
items.expect: No error. Seek targets by itself the creatures hiding from the Goblin within 5 squares (1 AP) or 10 (2 AP; from the sheet it asks which); no Doomed roll for Senses; on a Tier 2 or 3 the Goblin perceives her 1 step better. With nobody hiding in range it warns and spends nothing. Point Out on a Tier 2 asks which ally within 10 squares (or picks the only one) and improves its perception of Kaela 1 step; on a Tier 3, every ally within 10 squares.

items.title: Charge: an empty click deselects, the bar comes back; only the button confirms
items.do: On Durgan's turn, start a Charge and pick Orc Warrior. Click the Orc again. Click an empty part of the map, then select Durgan again. Click the Charge button. When the Charge ends in Reach, look at the HUD's Situational tab; another time, click its Cancel.
items.expect: Clicking the Orc again doesn't launch the Charge (only the button, or Enter, does). The empty click deselects Durgan; reselecting him brings the Charge bar back into his HUD. After the movement the Situational tab's "Charge · Basic Attack (1A)" pulses, as a Reaction does; Cancel removes it.
